datasets.name: uploads
datasets.select: SELECT id,filename,duration,size,status,create_time FROM media WHERE creater=? ORDER BY id
datasets.count: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM media WHERE creater=?

datasets.name: files
datasets.select: SELECT id,filename,status,platform,create_time FROM file WHERE creater=? ORDER BY id
datasets.count: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM file WHERE creater=?

datasets.name: cloud_uploads
datasets.select: SELECT id,filename,state,expected_size,duration_seconds,created_at FROM cloud_media_upload WHERE owner_id=? ORDER BY id
datasets.count: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cloud_media_upload WHERE owner_id=?

datasets.name: operations
datasets.select: SELECT operation_id,kind,status,error_code,created_at,updated_at FROM reliability_operation WHERE user_id=? ORDER BY created_at,operation_id
